title: GOAT Listing List Price Leaderboard
dataSources: StockX market prices (`stockx:price`), GOAT listings (`goat:listing`), Alias sales (`alias:sale`), sneaker rotation logs (`sneaker:rotation`), and deadstock age checks (`deadstock:age`).
app: StockX price alerts, GOAT listing exports, Alias seller settlement logs, sneaker rotation wear trackers, and deadstock age audits ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=goat:listing list_price_usd=*
| stats sum(list_price_usd) as total_value, avg(list_price_usd) as avg_value by sku
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks SKU values by total and average list price across GOAT listing events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `list_price_usd` values for each GOAT listing event and review total and average list price by SKU.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total list price.
grandmaExplanation: It flags which SKU shows the biggest list price numbers in your GOAT listing data.
